plansSection.title: Clear plans by objective.
plansSection.lead: The table focuses on the commercial value of each plan and the kind of business it can serve.

plans.name: Presence
plans.fit: For businesses that want a professional, clear presence ready to receive first inquiries.
plans.result: Expected result: a commercial base to explain what you do, who you serve, and how to start contact.
benefits: WhatsApp contact with an initial message.
Clear content to publish a professional first version.

plans.name: Customers
plans.fit: For businesses that want to explain their offer with more depth and receive more qualified conversations.
plans.result: Expected result: more clarity by service, plan, or customer profile.
benefits: More sections or pages to explain the offer.
Direct WhatsApp messages with more commercial context.

plans.name: Growth
plans.fit: For businesses with more offer depth, multiple audiences, or sector growth needs.
plans.result: Expected result: an expandable base for pages, campaigns, and continuous learning.
benefits: Content architecture to grow by topic or sector.
More commercial depth and decision-support elements.
Preparation for optimization and future improvements.

sections.title: Choose the plan by stage and commercial objective.
sections.lead: The recommendation depends on how developed your offer is, how many services you need to explain, and how much information you want to learn from inquiries.

cards.title: Start with your stage
cards.description: Presence works when you need to publish a professional base and open contact in an organized way.

cards.title: Think about your customers
cards.description: Customers helps when you serve multiple profiles or need to explain services with more detail.

cards.title: Plan growth
cards.description: Growth is useful when you want to expand pages by sectors, campaigns, or service lines.

faq.title: Pricing and initial scope
faq.lead: The WhatsApp conversation helps land the right scope.

items.title: How do I know which plan to choose?
items.content: We guide you based on your offer, number of services, available materials, and commercial objective.

items.title: Can I start with Presence and expand later?
items.content: Yes. We can plan a professional first version and later add pages by service, sector, or campaign.

items.title: Can pricing change by project?
items.content: Plans provide an initial reference. The conversation helps confirm scope, materials, timing, and priorities.

items.title: Which plan fits campaigns?
items.content: Customers or Growth usually provide more room for audience messaging, specific pages, and interest reading.

final.title: Ask for a plan recommendation.
final.lead: We will reply with a clear route based on your business, materials, and desired result.
